policy: Fail closed on uninspected binaries/media, symlinks, archive traversal, encrypted or oversized archives. Publish separately sanitized text copies; preserve authorized originals locally. Exact identity approval required before publication. The dedicated public-download cache admits only byte-identical reviewed upstream distributions under tools/cache_downloads.py pin/hash/size/path/link validation before reuse and immediately before save; generated binaries, build trees, logs, model inputs and pass verdicts remain excluded. General scanner binary rejection and inspection limits are unchanged.
